23.critic_justification: Codebase confirms AndroidManifest.xml requests ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION and LocationManager uses Priority.PRIORITY_HIGH_ACCURACY, despite MainViewModel+Concerts using location solely for a 50-mile radius concert search.

24.critic_justification: Codebase confirms LocationManager retrieves location and MainViewModel+Concerts transmits lat/lon off-device to Firebase without any in-app prominent disclosure dialog explaining location data collection.

27.critic_justification: Requesting RECORD_AUDIO permission for user-initiated voice commands and audio streaming is a standard Android permission pattern and fully compliant with Google Play policies.
